name: Hero Sprint
description: Run-and-gun stage: minor at 167 bpm, galloping saw bass, a nonstop sixteenth-note square arp, and a hook that arrives in the chorus after a pre-chorus climb. A loop, so the last bar leans back into the first. Testing whether the hook cuts through all that arp.
intent: Run-and-gun stage: minor at 167 bpm, galloping saw bass, a nonstop sixteenth-note square arp, and a hook that arrives in the chorus after a pre-chorus climb. A loop, so the last bar leans back into the first. Testing whether the hook cuts through all that arp.

name: Overworld Stroll
description: A bouncy adventure map in 2/4 (a march), lydian at 108 bpm: the raised 4th gives it a sunny, wide-open feel. Snare-march drums, a chirpy square hook, 12 bars that climb through a pre-chorus. Wanted optimism with a skip in its step.
intent: A bouncy adventure map in 2/4 (a march), lydian at 108 bpm: the raised 4th gives it a sunny, wide-open feel. Snare-march drums, a chirpy square hook, 12 bars that climb through a pre-chorus. Wanted optimism with a skip in its step.

name: Cathedral Run
description: Gothic castle chase: harmonic minor at 137 bpm, galloping bass, saw lead and a fast arp. The raised 7th is the drama. Sixteen bars: verse, a pre-chorus that climbs and drops out for a beat, then an 8-bar chorus with the hook coming back four times.
intent: Gothic castle chase: harmonic minor at 137 bpm, galloping bass, saw lead and a fast arp. The raised 7th is the drama. Sixteen bars: verse, a pre-chorus that climbs and drops out for a beat, then an 8-bar chorus with the hook coming back four times.

name: Spinning Blocks
description: A rolling folk-flavored puzzle loop in 6/8 (two groups of three), minor at 130 bpm, plucked hook over a walking bass and a march snare. Short on purpose, 8 bars, so it can repeat for an hour. Testing whether 6/8 gives it that spinning feeling.
intent: A rolling folk-flavored puzzle loop in 6/8 (two groups of three), minor at 130 bpm, plucked hook over a walking bass and a march snare. Short on purpose, 8 bars, so it can repeat for an hour. Testing whether 6/8 gives it that spinning feeling.

name: Coastline
description: A seaside drive loop with a pop shape: lydian at 121 bpm, four-on-the-floor, octave bass, a saw hook doubled a third below in the chorus. Sixteen bars: verse, a pre-chorus that climbs and drops out for a beat, then an 8-bar chorus that lands hard. Windows-down optimism.
intent: A seaside drive loop with a pop shape: lydian at 121 bpm, four-on-the-floor, octave bass, a saw hook doubled a third below in the chorus. Sixteen bars: verse, a pre-chorus that climbs and drops out for a beat, then an 8-bar chorus that lands hard. Windows-down optimism.

name: Hearth and Home
description: A vibe piece, not an earworm: a safe village in 3/4 (a slow waltz sway), major at 94 bpm. Soft rim-click drums, a walking bass, a flute-like motif that comes and goes. Wanted warmth and nothing demanding your attention.
intent: A vibe piece, not an earworm: a safe village in 3/4 (a slow waltz sway), major at 94 bpm. Soft rim-click drums, a walking bass, a flute-like motif that comes and goes. Wanted warmth and nothing demanding your attention.

name: Backroom Bazaar
description: A jazzy shop in 7/8 (grouped 2+2+3, a stumbling bustle), dorian at 121 bpm. Funk drums, syncopated bass, a plucked hook. The odd meter should feel like browsing: quick, a bit off-kilter, still a groove you can nod to.
intent: A jazzy shop in 7/8 (grouped 2+2+3, a stumbling bustle), dorian at 121 bpm. Funk drums, syncopated bass, a plucked hook. The odd meter should feel like browsing: quick, a bit off-kilter, still a groove you can nod to.

name: Last Throne
description: A final-boss loop: phrygian at 152 bpm (the flat 2nd is menace). Mostly 4/4, but every fourth bar drops a beat to 3/4, which makes it lurch. Galloping bass, a saw hook doubled in the chorus, a pre-chorus that climbs and cuts out before the chorus hits.
intent: A final-boss loop: phrygian at 152 bpm (the flat 2nd is menace). Mostly 4/4, but every fourth bar drops a beat to 3/4, which makes it lurch. Galloping bass, a saw hook doubled in the chorus, a pre-chorus that climbs and cuts out before the chorus hits.

name: Glass Tide
description: A vibe piece: slow underwater drift in 12/8 (four rolling groups of three), lydian at 67 bpm. No drums, a sub bass, a constant bell arp like light through water, and a sparse bell motif. Meant to be heard, not hummed. Floating, a little wonder.
intent: A vibe piece: slow underwater drift in 12/8 (four rolling groups of three), lydian at 67 bpm. No drums, a sub bass, a constant bell arp like light through water, and a sparse bell motif. Meant to be heard, not hummed. Floating, a little wonder.

name: Something Listens
description: A vibe piece: a dungeon in 5/4 (a 4/4 bar with one beat too many, never quite settled), phrygian at 60 bpm. Sparse drums, a lone flute-like motif with long gaps, a faint bell arp. Uneasy through space rather than noise.
intent: A vibe piece: a dungeon in 5/4 (a 4/4 bar with one beat too many, never quite settled), phrygian at 60 bpm. Sparse drums, a lone flute-like motif with long gaps, a faint bell arp. Uneasy through space rather than noise.

name: Hyperdrive
description: A frantic vibe piece: phrygian at 160 bpm, relentless eighth-note bass, a nonstop sixteenth square arp and driving drums with only a sparse lead over the top. The texture is the point, a scrolling starfield at speed. Not built to be hummed.
intent: A frantic vibe piece: phrygian at 160 bpm, relentless eighth-note bass, a nonstop sixteenth square arp and driving drums with only a sparse lead over the top. The texture is the point, a scrolling starfield at speed. Not built to be hummed.

name: Neon Groove
description: A funk stage: dorian at 108 bpm in 4/4, syncopated bass as the star, funk drums, a gritty saw hook. Sixteen bars with a climbing pre-chorus into an 8-bar chorus. Aiming for a head-nod that still sounds like a game level.
intent: A funk stage: dorian at 108 bpm in 4/4, syncopated bass as the star, funk drums, a gritty saw hook. Sixteen bars with a climbing pre-chorus into an 8-bar chorus. Aiming for a head-nod that still sounds like a game level.

name: Last Light
description: A wistful ballad loop: minor at 62 bpm in 3/4, a flute-like hook over whole-note bass and a bell arp. Twelve bars: verse, a pre-chorus that climbs, and a chorus that resolves on the tonic and then turns around into the verse. A quiet end-credits feel.
intent: A wistful ballad loop: minor at 62 bpm in 3/4, a flute-like hook over whole-note bass and a bell arp. Twelve bars: verse, a pre-chorus that climbs, and a chorus that resolves on the tonic and then turns around into the verse. A quiet end-credits feel.

name: Echo Cavern
description: A vibe piece: a cave in changing meter. Verses are in 5/4 and the rest in 4/4, so the floor shifts under you at each section. Dorian at 77 bpm, sparse drums, bell motif, plucked arp like dripping echo. Mysterious but friendly.
intent: A vibe piece: a cave in changing meter. Verses are in 5/4 and the rest in 4/4, so the floor shifts under you at each section. Dorian at 77 bpm, sparse drums, bell motif, plucked arp like dripping echo. Mysterious but friendly.

name: Cloud Drift
description: A vibe piece: a floating sky stage in 9/8 (three flowing groups of three), mixolydian at 93 bpm. Half-time drums, whole-note sub bass, a flute-like motif and a rolling plucked arp. Weightless and open, the opposite of the chase tracks.
intent: A vibe piece: a floating sky stage in 9/8 (three flowing groups of three), mixolydian at 93 bpm. Half-time drums, whole-note sub bass, a flute-like motif and a rolling plucked arp. Weightless and open, the opposite of the chase tracks.

name: Level Clear
description: A stinger for beating the level: four bars of 4/4 in major at about 132 bpm. A short hook, the same hook a step higher, a climbing run, then a held final chord with a crash while the tempo slows. Meant to land a hard, happy thump when something big just happened.
intent: A stinger for beating the level: four bars of 4/4 in major at about 132 bpm. A short hook, the same hook a step higher, a climbing run, then a held final chord with a crash while the tempo slows. Meant to land a hard, happy thump when something big just happened.

name: Game Over
description: A stinger for dying, three bars of 4/4 in minor at about 96 bpm: a falling line over a sinking chord, slowing to about half speed and ending on a very low held tonic. No celebration, no hook, just a heavy slump so the failure registers.
intent: A stinger for dying, three bars of 4/4 in minor at about 96 bpm: a falling line over a sinking chord, slowing to about half speed and ending on a very low held tonic. No celebration, no hook, just a heavy slump so the failure registers.

name: Boss Down
description: A stinger for a boss going down, four bars of 4/4 in mixolydian at about 112 bpm: a heavy low motif said twice, a leap onto the dominant, then a crash on a deep tonic with the tempo dragging to a stop. Weighty and victorious rather than bright.
intent: A stinger for a boss going down, four bars of 4/4 in mixolydian at about 112 bpm: a heavy low motif said twice, a leap onto the dominant, then a crash on a deep tonic with the tempo dragging to a stop. Weighty and victorious rather than bright.

name: Power Up
description: A stinger for a power-up, two bars in 6/8 at about 160 bpm and speeding up: a rising lydian arpeggio that climbs two octaves, then the top note rings with a sparkle of bells. Short and bright, under three seconds. A reward cue, not a tune.
intent: A stinger for a power-up, two bars in 6/8 at about 160 bpm and speeding up: a rising lydian arpeggio that climbs two octaves, then the top note rings with a sparkle of bells. Short and bright, under three seconds. A reward cue, not a tune.

name: Secret Found
description: A stinger for finding a secret, three bars in 3/4 at about 76 bpm: bells climbing out of the dark over a swelling pad, ending on a shimmering lydian chord as it slows. Wonder and mystery, no beat.
intent: A stinger for finding a secret, three bars in 3/4 at about 76 bpm: bells climbing out of the dark over a swelling pad, ending on a shimmering lydian chord as it slows. Wonder and mystery, no beat.
